title: Canopy leak at night 80 miles from the carrier
place_text: About 80 miles west of the aircraft carrier, 30,000 ft

tellings.quote: I was about 80 miles west of the boat, 30,000 feet or so, um, nighttime, and all of a sudden my canopy starts leaking.

plain: A Navy fighter pilot named Ryan Graves says that one night he was flying about 80 miles west of his aircraft carrier at around 30,000 feet when his canopy suddenly started leaking. He tells Michels this himself, as one of his own experiences of things going wrong in the cockpit far from the ship.
